To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the proposed decentralized control algorithm has been successfully implemented in wireless sensor nodes and tested on a 3-story structure; 2) the decentralized control algorithm has successfully eliminated communication latency problems in the wireless structural sensing and monitoring system; 3) the proposed wireless sensor nodes have been successfully integrated into a wireless structural control system and tested on a half-scale steel structure; 4) the proposed decentralized wireless sensing and control system provides a cost-effective and efficient alternative to traditional structural control systems.
decentralized control algorithms can be used to improve the performance of a wireless structural control system by reducing communication latency.
the decentralized control strategy is effective in reducing the communication latency problem in wireless structural control system.
